creative_pass.still_prompt: Reference-matched Zantara, alone and knees-up mid-stride inside an edge-to-edge limestone atrium, unobstructed frontal face, ivory silk blouse, restrained gold embroidery, natural daylight.
creative_pass.video_prompt: Zantara walks calmly and decisively as the camera tracks backward at eye level, ending centered while a foreground limestone edge nearly fills the frame.
